_comment: Verified against Magisk v31.x / master (Compose UI). v30.7 and older used
HomeFragment.kt (DataBinding) and are NOT covered by these rules.
Every rule must match exactly once; apply_temp_root.py fails the build
otherwise, so a half-patched APK is never produced.

rules.why: hide the uninstall icon in the Home top app bar

rules.replace: \1val actionLabel: String? = null // TempRoot: no core Install/Update button
rules.why: CoreCard: never offer Install/Update/Reinstall of the Magisk core

rules.replace: \1if (actionLabel != null && false) { // TempRoot: no manager reinstall button\n\2Spacer(Modifier.width(4.dp))
rules.why: AppCard: hide the manager Reinstall/Update button

rules.replace: \1if (uiState.magiskState != HomeViewModel.State.INVALID) CoreCard( // TempRoot: only after su\n\2modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),\n\3state = uiState.magiskState,
rules.why: hide the whole Magisk card until root is available
rename the Magisk card title to Magisk（越獄模式） and show it only when rooted

rules.replace: \1if (showEnvFixDialog && false) { // TempRoot: never prompt to fix the environment\n\2EnvFixComposableDialog(

rules.why: settings: hide the update channel selector

rules.replace: \1if (false) SettingsArrow( // TempRoot: no patch-boot tool\n\2title = stringResource(CoreR.string.patch_image),
rules.why: install dialog: remove the 'patch a file' (boot image) entry
